weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 今天，白羊座，你可能會散發出魅力和活力，使你特別有吸引力。你的心是敞開的，特別是對毛茸茸的朋友，所以如果你一直在考慮帶寵物進入你的生活，今天是一個很好的機會。在專業方面，與工作和財務相關的一切看起來都很有希望。整體而言，你正處於積極的心態，應該會持續很長一段時間。
aries.horoscope_en: Today, Aries, you are likely to radiate charm and vitality, making you particularly appealing. Your heart is open, especially towards furry friends, so if you've been thinking about bringing a pet into your life, today is an excellent opportunity. On the professional front, everything related to work and finances is looking promising. Overall, you're in a positive mindset that should carry you through for quite a while.

taurus.horoscope: 今天，金牛座，你的心很可能會充滿對親人的愛，特別是對朋友和孩子的愛。您可能會發現自己被藝術追求所吸引，無論是觀看戲劇或音樂會，還是探索自己的創意才能。隨著夜幕降臨，請盡一切可能與朋友建立聯繫，盡情享受團結的樂趣！
taurus.horoscope_en: Today, Taurus, your heart is likely to overflow with affection for your loved ones, especially friends and children. You may find yourself drawn to artistic pursuits, whether that means catching a play or concert or even exploring your own creative talents. As the evening rolls in, make it a point to connect with your friends and relish the joy of togetherness in any way you can!
taurus.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座的今天，你可能會受到啟發，為每個房間購買一棵植物，甚至創建一個花園，為你的家帶來一絲大自然的氣息。如果天氣宜人，不妨考慮前往當地的苗圃或植物園。雖然您通常對綠色植物不太感興趣，但今天美麗和自然世界的吸引力特別強烈。擁抱這種轉瞬即逝的靈感，因為它將增強您生活空間的美感！
gemini.horoscope_en: Today, Gemini, you may feel inspired to bring a touch of nature into your home by purchasing a plant for each room or even starting a garden. If the weather is pleasant, consider taking a trip to a local nursery or botanical garden. While you might not usually have a strong interest in greenery, today the allure of beauty and the natural world is particularly strong. Embrace this fleeting inspiration, as it will enhance the beauty of your living space!

cancer.horoscope: 今天，你可能會收到來自親人的衷心訊息，無論是透過電話、電子郵件，還是貼心的禮物。巨蟹座，這個手勢可能會照亮你的一天，你會發現自己與朋友和家人分享積極的能量。不妨考慮在鄰近地區漫步，並與您遇到的人打招呼；這將進一步提升您的心情！
cancer.horoscope_en: Today, you might receive a heartfelt message from a loved one, whether it's through a phone call, an email, or perhaps a thoughtful gift. This gesture is likely to brighten your day, Cancer, and you'll find yourself sharing that positive energy with friends and family. Consider taking a stroll in your neighborhood and greeting those you encounter; it will enhance your mood even further!

leo.horoscope: 今天，獅子座，你可能會發現自己對意想不到的現金流入感到驚訝。不妨利用這筆新發現的財富作為你的優勢--無論是明智地投資，還是為你的個人努力獲得材料。你的財務前景特別光明，你可以相信自己的技能可以創造更多收入。
leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, you might find yourself pleasantly surprised by an unexpected influx of cash. Consider using this newfound wealth to your advantage—whether that means investing it wisely or acquiring materials for your personal endeavors. Your outlook on finances is particularly bright, and you can trust in your skills to generate more income.

virgo.horoscope: 今天，處女座，你可能會發現你對周圍的每個人都充滿了愛，即使是那些通常會讓你感到緊張的人。你的魅力可能會閃耀，讓你比平時更有吸引力和自信。你甚至可能會受到啟發，用一些新的衣物來刷新你的衣櫃。創造性的想法可以毫不費力地來到您身邊，您可能會發現創新的方法來將這些想法變為現實。
virgo.horoscope_en: Today, Virgo, you might find your heart overflowing with affection for everyone around you, even those who typically get on your nerves. Your charm is likely to shine through, making you feel more attractive and self-assured than usual. You may even feel inspired to refresh your wardrobe with some new pieces. Creative thoughts could come to you effortlessly, and you might discover innovative ways to bring those ideas to life.

libra.horoscope: 你親愛的人，很久沒有聯繫上，可能會意外地聯絡你。天秤座，通常你會很興奮，但今天你可能會發現自己太專注於自己的任務，無法輕鬆轉移注意力。但是，與此人共度時光可能是一個愉快的休息時間，您甚至可能會激發他們對您正在進行的工作的興趣。完成專案後，不妨訂購美味外賣，好好犒賞自己。
libra.horoscope_en: A person dear to you, whom you haven't connected with in ages, might reach out unexpectedly. Normally, you'd be thrilled, Libra, but today you might find yourself too engrossed in your own tasks to easily shift your focus. However, spending time with this individual could be a delightful break, and you may even spark their interest in what you're working on. Once you've wrapped up your projects, treat yourself to some tasty takeout.

scorpio.horoscope: 天蠍座，當你達到一個重要目標時，你為之奮鬥的那一刻可能終於到來。與多年未曾見過的朋友重聚的機會可能即將來臨，如果可以的話，你會渴望加入。預期一段愉快的時光，與他們分享最新消息並交換想法。重新連接的喜悅可能會提升你的精神，讓你意識到在再次聚集之前不要讓太多的時間過去是多麼重要。
scorpio.horoscope_en: Scorpio, the moment you've been striving for may finally arrive as you achieve a significant goal. A reunion with friends you haven't caught up with in ages could be on the horizon, and you'll be eager to join in if you can. Anticipate a delightful time filled with sharing updates and exchanging thoughts with them. The joy of reconnecting will likely lift your spirits, making you realize how important it is not to let too much time pass before you gather again.
scorpio.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

sagittarius.horoscope: 今天，射手座，你可能會遇到一些迷人的新人。其中一個可能會與你的興趣產生共鳴，並可能演變成珍貴的友誼。您在這些對話中發現的樂趣必然會增強您的一整天，使您與周圍的人更加平易近人和友好。隨著傍晚的臨近，請務必沉迷於一些愉快的活動。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Today, Sagittarius, you may encounter some fascinating new individuals. One of them is likely to resonate with your interests and could evolve into a cherished friendship. The delight you find in these conversations is bound to enhance your entire day, making you more approachable and friendly with those around you. As the evening approaches, be sure to indulge in some enjoyable activities.
sagittarius.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

capricorn.horoscope: 你可能會發現自己被遙遠國度摩羯座的書籍或電影迷住了，讓你覺得特別迷人。造訪這個地方的想法可能會在你的腦海中根深蒂固。如果這個想法讓你感到興奮，不妨考慮為未來的探險奠定基礎。你目前的心態是基礎和實際的，你有追求這個夢想的動力。在規劃旅程時，盡情探索旅遊手冊和地圖！
capricorn.horoscope_en: You may find yourself enchanted by a book or film set in a distant land, Capricorn, making it feel particularly alluring. The thought of visiting this place might start to take root in your mind. If this idea excites you, consider laying the groundwork for a future adventure. Your current mindset is grounded and practical, and you have the motivation to pursue this dream. Enjoy exploring travel brochures and maps as you plan your journey!
capricorn.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

aquarius.horoscope: 你圈子裡欠你的人可能會意外地帶著他們欠的現金出現，水瓶座。這個驚喜可能會給你帶來快樂。你可能會想請朋友吃午餐，或用這筆錢購買一份貼心的禮物。今晚，你可能會經歷一些在你腦海中徘徊的迷人夢境，可能會讓你在醒來時感到有點不安。請務必將它們記下來；它們擁有關於你內在自我的寶貴見解。
aquarius.horoscope_en: A person in your circle who has been in debt to you could unexpectedly show up with the cash they owe, Aquarius. This surprise will likely bring you joy. You might feel tempted to treat a friend to lunch or purchase a thoughtful gift with some of that money. Tonight, you may experience some enchanting dreams that linger in your mind, possibly leaving you feeling a bit unsettled upon waking. Be sure to jot them down; they hold valuable insights about your inner self.
aquarius.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

pisces.horoscope: 今天，雙魚座，你的心很可能會充滿對你所愛的人的愛，特別是你的浪漫伴侶。不妨考慮抽出一些時間與朋友或家人聯繫，或者與親人計劃一個特別的夜晚--理想情況下，為什麼不兩者兼而有之？如果有任何需要您注意的文件或任務，今天是解決這些問題的最佳日子。您處於實際的心態並感到樂觀，因此即使是最平凡的家務也不會抑制您的精神。
pisces.horoscope_en: Today, Pisces, your heart is likely to overflow with affection for those you hold dear, especially your romantic partner. Consider carving out some time to connect with friends or family, or perhaps plan a special evening with your loved one—ideally, why not do both? If there are any documents or tasks that need your attention, today is the perfect day to tackle them. You're in a practical mindset and feeling upbeat, so even the most mundane chores won't dampen your spirits.
